On its own, an AI chat model only writes text. So how does an AI agent check the weather, or send an email?

Here's the trick. With your question, the app gives the model a menu of tools: each has a name and a plain description.

Ask: do I need a jacket in Austin? The model doesn't run anything. It writes out a request: use the weather tool, for Austin.

The app reads that request and does the real work: it asks a weather service, and gets an answer.

The app hands that answer back to the model, as another message. Now the model can reply: yes, take a jacket.

That's the loop: the model asks, the app acts, the model reads the result. Sometimes it repeats before the final answer.

Next: what happens when a tool call goes wrong?
